summary: Frontend-only E2E of Duplicate Review human-in-the-loop feature on /bank-transactions Duplicates tab. Seeded 6 UIQA Bank ingests (3 pairs) via /api/bank-transactions/ingest producing 3 pending + 3 duplicate records. Verified: (a) Duplicates tab shows possible-duplicate cards with 'POSSIBLE DUPLICATE — needs your review', card-dup-score (100%), and all three action buttons (card-dup-compare-btn / card-dup-reject-btn / card-dup-approve-btn). (b) Compare dialog renders dup-current + dup-match columns with all 8 field rows, dup-reasons list containing 'Same amount' and other match reasons, dup-score 'Duplicate confidence: 100%', and the two decision buttons. (c) Approve as New opens directly to dup-approve-confirm; dup-approve-submit is disabled when reason is empty AND when reason has 3 chars, enabled at 5+ chars. Submitting posts a success toast 'Duplicate warning overridden — now in Pending for normal approval', duplicate counter decreases, pending counter increases; the moved record in Pending shows dup-override-note with the reviewer, reason and dup-override-compare 'view match' link, plus card-approve-btn. (d) Clicking Approve & Post on the override card moves it to Approved tab where dup-override-note persists. (e) Reject as Duplicate opens dup-reject-confirm; dup-reject-submit succeeds; Duplicates tab counter format switches to '2 +1' (review count + rejected count); rejected card is greyed with 'REJECTED AS DUPLICATE' badge, dup-rejected-by line, no action buttons, and appears BELOW the remaining possible duplicates in the list. (f) Counter arithmetic pending(90)+approved(4)+rejected(1)+duplicate(2)+duplicate_rejected(1) == all(98). (g) view-table regression renders bank-table-view with statuses; Pending normal cards continue to show card-approve-btn/card-reject-btn/card-edit-btn (90 each). No console errors related to the feature.
critical_code_review_comments: DuplicateReviewDialog: after successful approve/reject, the flow calls onChanged() then onOpenChange(false) sequentially — works correctly. During Playwright inspection the dialog element was transiently detected as 'visible' just after click due to Radix close animation; visually and functionally it closes and toast appears. Non-issue.
BankTxnCard.jsx line ~76 dup-override-compare 'view match' link is inside a bg-neutral-50 wrapper — good contrast; text-amber-800 on bg-amber-50 also has adequate contrast.
